title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — if death-name = hereditary: leaves interpreters; helps Pelagians
pass_a_gloss: But if you say he packed that hereditary corruption—which is sin—under the name of death: first you leave the consent of all interpreters I have seen. Next you help the Pelagians against Augustine, who take 'death' as death of the soul.
pass_b_english: But if you shall say that the Apostle comprehended that hereditary corruption, which is sin, under the name of death, first you will depart from the consent of all interpreters (whom I have seen). Next you will help the cause of the Pelagians against Augustine, who take the name of death of the death of the soul.
source_text: Si vero dixeris, Apostolum mortis nomine corruptionem illam haereditariam, quae peccatum est, comprehendisse, primum discedes ab omnium (quos viderim) interpretum consensu. Deinde causam Pelagianorum adversus Augustinum iuvabis, mortis nomen de morte animae accipientium.

choices.choice: Pack under 'death' leaves interpreters; helps Pelagians vs Augustine
